before.title: Alto / Wagon R K10B Valve Clearance Service (Shim-Under-Bucket)
before.description: The K10B 1.0 3-cylinder in Alto, Celerio (early), Splash, and Wagon R uses shim-under-bucket valve adjustment — not the more common hydraulic lash adjusters. Suzuki specifies a check at 96,000 km but many owners (and dealers) skip it; tight valves over time cause burned exhaust valves and failed compression.
before.solution: Valve clearance check + adjustment at 96,000 km is in the service book — confirm it has been done. £200-£400 labor + shims. If skipped repeatedly, eventually a leak-down test will reveal valve burn — head rebuild £700-£1,200.
